STRComparison: the result of comparing STR profiles

Source: R/AllClasses.R
STRComparison-class.Rd

An S4 container returned by compareProfiles(), holding every pairwise score alongside a per-query summary and the parameters used to produce them.

Value

An object of class STRComparison.

Slots

scores

A S4Vectors::DataFrame with one row per query/reference pair.

summary

A S4Vectors::DataFrame with one row per query sample.

query

The query STRProfiles.

reference

The reference STRProfiles. Identical to query for an all-against-all comparison.

params

A list of the scoring and threshold parameters used.

See also

compareProfiles() to build one, writeSTRResults() to write it out.

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "ExampleSTR_long.csv", package = "STRprofilerR")
db <- system.file("extdata", "ExampleSTR_database.csv", package = "STRprofilerR")
cmp <- compareProfiles(
    readSTRProfiles(f, sampleCol = "Sample Name"),
    readSTRProfiles(db, sampleCol = "Sample Name")
)
cmp
#> class: STRComparison
#> queries(2): SampleA SampleB
#> references(5)
#> comparisons: 10
#> thresholds: tanabe=80 mastersQuery=80 mastersRef=80
#> useAmel: FALSE
#> flagged as mixed: 0
